EXCISION: only the 3-bullet risk list itself was removed from data/processed/P-UK-FreeBreakfastClubs.txt (replaced with a bracketed excision marker), not the surrounding Economic Case section, which is legitimate planning content (BCR figures, sensitivity analysis, options shortlist, rationale). REJECTED CANDIDATE NOTE: P-UK-ConnectToWork was evaluated alongside this document in the same decision round and excluded (not included at any tier) - it had only 2 risks, zero mitigation content on either, and zero category diversity (both risks were the same underlying funding-ramp-up timing issue).
